findings: inspect_db is a diagnostic, not an indexer or duplicate matcher. Counts and printed FTS hits have no expected-result assertions; image OCR is explicitly not run, PDF/DOCX extraction skipped.

indexer_state prepare failure is printed as absent/unqueryable; per-row conversion failures are silently skipped, count_folder query errors become zero. Diagnostic success does not establish complete index health.
